messages:
alex: heads up — saw several tenants silently switch back to v1 this morning. console shows 'v2 preferred' but routing logs show fallbacks when seqlen spikes. billing telemetry also counts tokens on both variants which is making quotas look inflated :grimacing:

maria: ugh. is the fallback happening because v2 latency breaches SLO or because of a model-compat mismatch? any example request traces?

alex: mostly latency SLO. spike window around long chat sessions. trace: `route=(v2) -> fallback=(v1) at 2026-03-22T09:12:03Z` — we get duplicate token counting since both attempts are billed.

kevin: double-charge is bad. we should avoid billing client for retries/fallbacks when fallback is automatic. options: 1) attribute tokens to final route only (server-side ledger), 2) stop sending request body to v1 when v2 will handle (risky), 3) add a lightweight `x-rw-version-confidence` header so console + billing can decide attribution.

sara: option 1 is safest. implement a server-side ledger: log attempts and mark 'attributed_route' after success. then billing can backfill. but that needs a migration window for accounting. also need to update dashboard to surface when attribution is pending.

jonathan: agree. also propose a short-lived 'confidence score' in the routing decision so console can show an orange badge: "version confidence: 65%" and users can pin behavior. UX idea: expose a toggle "prefer stable v1 during low confidence" with sample rate.

maria: love the badge idea. for telemetry, let's emit a metric `route_version_confidence{tenant,route}` and a trace tag `version_confidence`. sampling at 1% by default to avoid cardinality explosion.

kevin: implementation note: add `x-rw-attribution-id` to root request and propagate to retries. ledger entries: `id, attempts[], final_route, tokens_attributed, timestamp`. then billing can reconcile asynchronously. pseudocode: ```
// on request
id = uuid()
attempt(id, v2)
if fallback -> attempt(id, v1)
// on final success
ledger.write({id, attempts, final_route, tokens})
```

alex: that handles billing but we should also prevent consoles from showing misleading per-route token bars in realtime. propose: show "unattributed tokens" in the route breakdown until ledger reconciles.

sara: +1. add a console tooltip: "tokens pending attribution — reconciles in ~5m". ops: set reconciliation lag SLA to 10m. also create an alert if >1% of requests stay unattributed after 30m.

jonathan: who wants to own the rollout? i can do the console badges + dashboard changes. kevin can do ledger/attribution. alex to wire routing changes and add header propagation. sara to update alerting and billing reconciliation job. i'll create an RFC and a tiny canary for a subset of tenants.

alex: sounds good. i'll draft the RFC now and include a short query for the new metric. quick question — do we need UX for tenants to opt out of automatic fallback (hard pin to v2)?

maria: yes, add an "enforce" pin that disables automatic fallbacks (explicitly opts into potential errors). default should remain permissive. document in console copy.

routing-bot: deploy request queued: `attribution-ledger-service` patch v0.3.1 -> canary on us-west-2, subset=5 tenants.

kevin: thanks — i'll watch the canary and follow up with reconciliation runbook.
